title: HumaniBench: A Human-Centric Framework for Large Multimodal Models Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures prejudice and stereotyping tied to protected attributes. 'Religion' is mentioned as one example of a protected attribute in the bias metric definition, but it is not systematically measured or analyzed in the paper's tasks, which focus on age, gender, race/ethnicity, occupation, and sport.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the evaluation.
